Those facts must be recovered from C++, Rust, Fortran, logs, and twin/control runs.

hardness_axes.name: Synthesize
hardness_axes.reasoning: Interrupted/uninterrupted parity requires coordinated behavior across native geometry lifecycle, host checkpoint shelf and assembly reuse, and pack-side field fold/digest. No single module owns the complete invariant.

hardness_axes.name: Diagnose

hardness_axes.name: Navigate coupling

hardness_axes.name: Reason beyond training

discovery_budget.discovery: The mid-run checkpoint omits or misbinds a geometry generation token that must round-trip across the C++/Rust boundary so post-remesh identity matches the never-interrupted twin.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming a missing geometry token or cross-language binding would collapse the native diagnosis into a disclosed serialization edit.

discovery_budget.discovery: After remesh, host-side assembly/operator reuse continues under a pre-remesh identity key, so residual norms can look plausible while the solution trajectory diverges from the twin.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming operator reuse, cache keying, or invalidation would directly expose the host repair and convert the task into a recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: Pack-side field packing and digest folding retain pre-remesh ordering or scratch, so emitted solution-field digests disagree even when upstream residuals look ordinary.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming pre-remesh ordering or retained scratch would reduce the Fortran work to a disclosed layout flip.

causal_chain.evidence: Run the bundled remesh+resume case beside its never-interrupted twin and the fresh no-checkpoint control; compare residual norms, iteration counts, and solution-field digests.
causal_chain.finding: Residual norms and iteration counts can look plausible after resume while field digests disagree with the twin; the no-checkpoint control stays correct.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: The conditional matrix justifies treating residual-green / digest-red as one remesh+resume incident rather than a general residual bug.

causal_chain.evidence: Inspect run logs, metrics counters, and parity_report.json fields for interrupted versus uninterrupted trajectories.
causal_chain.finding: Disagreement concentrates on solution-field digests and pointwise residual samples after the remesh boundary, not on fresh no-checkpoint runs.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Investigation can focus on state that crosses the pause/remesh/resume boundary across language roots.

causal_chain.evidence: Trace checkpoint shelf contents and native geometry lifecycle observations across the FFI boundary for matched twins.
causal_chain.finding: A geometry generation token is omitted or rebound incorrectly when the shelf restores mid-run state.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Geometry-identity repair becomes a necessary but not sufficient stage before reuse and packing are trusted.

causal_chain.evidence: Compare host assembly/operator reuse decisions before and after remesh using deterministic probes and shelf keys.
causal_chain.finding: Reuse continues under a pre-remesh identity, explaining residual-plausible / digest-wrong behavior after resume.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Reuse keying must be repaired in concert with geometry identity; packing still remains unchecked.

causal_chain.evidence: Inspect pack-side fold/digest intermediates and ordering metadata for remeshed versus uninterrupted trajectories.
causal_chain.finding: Digest folding retains pre-remesh ordering or scratch, so emitted digests disagree even after upstream residuals look ordinary.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: The three authorities can now be repaired as one coupled invariant and verified end-to-end.

causal_chain.evidence: Apply coordinated repairs at native, host, and pack locations; rebuild; rerun twin, interrupted, and no-checkpoint matrices.
causal_chain.finding: Interrupted and uninterrupted trajectories agree on field digests and residual contracts; the healthy no-checkpoint control remains byte-identical.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: This closes the incident with deterministic outcome evidence.

investigation_profile.determinism_strategy: Ship fixed C++/Rust/Fortran sources, bundled cases, shelf fixtures, and logs in one offline container. Reset from immutable inputs before each scenario, avoid clocks and runtime entropy, sort filesystem traversal, pin reduction order for digests, and derive expected twin/control properties from verifier-owned regeneration.

domain_reasoning.domain: Scientific computing for mesh-based solvers with checkpoint/restart after remesh and mixed-language field digests.
domain_reasoning.why_not_trivia: The solver does not need an obscure standard clause. They must reconcile geometry identity, post-remesh reuse, and packing/digest fold across three languages while proving twin parity and preserving a healthy no-checkpoint control.

attack_path.summary: Reproduce twin digest disagreement beside a healthy no-checkpoint control, falsify residual-kernel and random-IO hypotheses, then reconcile geometry-token binding, post-remesh reuse keying, and pack-side fold order across three roots.
attack_path.reasoning: The path requires experiments and cross-language model building; no prompt noun, file name, or single failed assertion reveals all three locations.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Coordinated substantive edits to one C++ geometry lifecycle function, one Rust shelf/reuse function, and one Fortran fold/digest function, together exceeding a trivial patch.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Any strict subset leaves at least one twin-parity, residual-contract, or no-checkpoint stability property failing.

collapse_audit.reasoning: The editable frontier spans three non-obvious locations across three language roots, the instruction remains symptoms-only, no declarative cluster or reference digest exists, and the planned oracle adds substantive logic rather than deleting or toggling one feature.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: After the complete file tree is visible, the solver must still identify why remesh+resume trajectories cross different geometry, reuse, and fold authorities and then preserve one twin/control invariant through three locations.

topology_enumeration.summary: Geometry-token binding, post-remesh reuse keying, and pack-side fold/digest disagree across native, host, and pack roots.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: A correct geometry token can still be ignored by reuse keying, correct reuse can still emit wrong digests under pre-remesh fold order, and packing-only repairs leave twin residual contracts red when shelf and native lifecycle disagree.

topology_enumeration.summary: Checkpoint write, remesh authority handoff, resume rebind, and digest emission form a four-stage lifecycle chain.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Correct shelf writes are useless if geometry identity is wrong, correct geometry is useless if resume rebinds the wrong authority, and correct upstream state is useless if digests fold the wrong order.

topology_enumeration.summary: Native index maps, host reuse keys, and Fortran reduction order use incompatible conventions after remesh.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Changing one convention only moves the disagreement to another boundary; producers and consumers must represent the same post-remesh identity-to-digest map.
